templates.name: Go pprof profile index is publicly reachable
templates.evidence: The response matches the Go net/http/pprof profile index and advertises runtime profiles. The check does not request profile or trace data.
templates.remediation: Restrict pprof to localhost or an authenticated management network. Remove the public route if runtime profiling is not required.

templates.name: Spring Boot Actuator mappings endpoint is publicly reachable
templates.evidence: The response matches the Spring Boot Actuator mappings structure, which lists application request mappings. This confirms the management endpoint is reachable; review whether that information should be public.
templates.remediation: Disable the mappings endpoint or restrict Actuator endpoints to authenticated users and a trusted management network.

templates.name: Django technical 404 page indicates DEBUG mode is enabled
templates.evidence: The missing-route response contains Django's technical 404 diagnostics and explicitly reports DEBUG = True. The page can disclose URL patterns and request metadata.
templates.remediation: Set DEBUG=False in production and configure a standard 404 handler. Keep debug diagnostics available only in a development environment.

templates.name: OpenAPI specification is publicly reachable
templates.evidence: An unauthenticated GET to /openapi.json returned JSON containing OpenAPI specification markers. The response body is not included in the report; public API documentation may be intentional.
templates.remediation: Review whether the API specification is intended to be public. If it exposes internal routes, restrict access or publish a curated specification.

templates.name: Swagger / OpenAPI v3 documentation is publicly reachable
templates.evidence: An unauthenticated GET to /v3/api-docs returned JSON containing OpenAPI specification markers. The response body is not included in the report; public API documentation may be intentional.
templates.remediation: Review whether the API specification is intended to be public. If it exposes internal routes, restrict access or publish a curated specification.

templates.name: Git repository configuration is publicly reachable
templates.evidence: An unauthenticated GET to /.git/config returned Git repository configuration markers. The response body and any remote values are not copied into the report; review whether source-control metadata is publicly accessible.
templates.remediation: Deny web access to the .git directory and remove repository metadata from the deployed document root. Review exposed configuration for internal paths or credentials.

templates.name: PHP configuration diagnostic page is publicly reachable
templates.evidence: The response matches PHP's configuration-information page. phpinfo output can disclose runtime settings, environment data, paths, and loaded extensions; response contents are not copied into the report.
templates.remediation: Remove public phpinfo pages or restrict them to an authenticated administrative network. Review and rotate any secrets that may have been displayed.

templates.name: Apache server status page is publicly reachable
templates.evidence: The response matches Apache mod_status output. Depending on configuration, this page can disclose worker activity, current requests, client hosts, and server performance data; response contents are not copied into the report.
templates.remediation: Restrict mod_status to an authenticated administrative or monitoring network. Disable the handler when it is not required.

templates.name: Go expvar runtime metrics are publicly reachable
templates.evidence: The response matches Go expvar's standard runtime variables and exposes process arguments and memory statistics. The response body is not included in the report.
templates.remediation: Restrict diagnostic metrics to an authenticated monitoring network or remove the public expvar handler.
